sampleNote: Sample expert answers and feedback text, only for trying the comparison. Write the real answers in the answer key editor (grading-editor.html) before students use this.

params.label: Imported files
params.off: Some of the files you imported are not the ones this case uses, or they do not belong together.

params.label: Pelvic plane
params.off: The plane is not where most experts put it. It should sit across the back of the pelvis, where the socket starts to thicken.

params.label: Min lattice thickness
params.low: Thinner struts than the experts chose. Thin struts save weight but flex, and they can crack where the straps pull.
params.high: Thicker struts than the experts chose. Thick struts are stiff but heavy and trap heat against a small dog.

params.label: Max lattice thickness
params.low: A thinner maximum than the experts chose, so the load-bearing areas may not stiffen enough.
params.high: A thicker maximum than the experts chose, adding weight where the socket should stay light.

params.label: Spatial weighting
params.low: Less weighting toward the loaded areas than the experts chose, so thickness is spread more evenly.
params.high: More weighting toward the loaded areas than the experts chose, so the rest of the socket stays thin.

params.label: Lattice point density
params.low: A lower lattice point density than the experts chose. Bigger openings are lighter and cooler, but the shell gets floppy.
params.high: A higher lattice point density than the experts chose. A dense lattice is stiffer but heavier and traps more heat.

params.label: Interface plane
params.off: The interface plane is not where most experts put it. Check which face of the scan the leg mount should sit on.

params.label: Lateral angle
params.low: Tilted further one way than the experts. A big sideways tilt pushes the leg out from under the body.
params.high: Tilted further the other way than the experts. A big sideways tilt pushes the leg out from under the body.

params.label: Medial angle
params.low: Angled more toward the midline than the experts. Too much and the leg crosses under the body.
params.high: Angled more away from the midline than the experts. Too much and the paw splays outward.

params.label: Interface rotation
params.low: Turned more one way than the experts. The paw would point off the walking line.
params.high: Turned more the other way than the experts. The paw would point off the walking line.
